findings.claim: Check returns a denial immediately from permDenialCache but ignores denials in the permission cache so that new grants are picked up. Once a denial is stored in permDenialCache, any permission granted afterward is blocked for up to the cache TTL.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:116-121, Check immediately returns Allowed: false on a permDenialCache hit, whereas pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:123-136 only short-circuits permCache hits when allowed is true so denials fall through to the database. Because pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:153-155 stores DB denials in permDenialCache for shortCacheTTL (30s, configured at pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:85) with no invalidation in pkg/services/authz/rbac/cache.go, any permission granted afterward for that request is blocked until the cache TTL expires.

findings.claim: TestService_getUserPermissions no longer has a cacheHit:true case, so the cacheHit field and both 'if tc.cacheHit' branches are dead. No test asserts the always-go-to-store behavior or the removed anonymous cache read.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/authz/rbac/service_test.go:333-395, removing the cacheHit:true case from TestService_getUserPermissions leaves the cacheHit field (line 337) always false and both 'if tc.cacheHit' branches (lines 367-369 and 388-390) dead. No test directly asserts that getUserPermissions always queries the store when permCache is populated (TestService_CacheCheck at lines 947-972 only exercises outdated-cache fallback through Check without asserting store calls), and no test covers the removed cache read in getAnonymousPermissions (pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:419-437).

findings.claim: The newly added log message 'could not check permission' starts with a lowercase letter, which violates the convention that messages start with a capital letter.

verifier.reason: Although pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:127 adds a lowercase log message `could not check permission`, no capitalization convention exists in contribute/backend/style-guide.md or .golangci.yml, and every existing log message in pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go (including the identical pre-existing line at pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:148) and pkg/services/authz/rbac/cache.go starts with a lowercase letter.
